newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Federal Savings to restructure.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Federal Savings to restructure.

text.p: Fidelity Federal Savings Bank of Florida said it had received regulatory approval to reorganize into a two-tier mutual holding company structure through the establishment of Fidelity Bankshares Inc, a Delaware corporation.
Pursuant to the bank's plan of reorganization, Fidelity Bankshares will become the majority-owned subsidiary of Fidelity Bankshares, the mutual holding company parent of the bank, it said.
The bank, meanwhile, will become the wholly-owned subsidiary of Fidelity Bankshares Inc, it added.

"Following completion of the reorganization, Fidelity Bankshares, Inc. will continue the bank's current dividend policy," it said. "Initially, the ownership interests of our mutual holding company and public stockholders in Fidelity Bankshares, Inc. will remain the same as they are in the bank today."
